narrative.executive_summary: Your platform currently faces operational and compliance risks due to inventory imbalance, pricing anomalies, and sales data integrity issues, which may impact revenue and customer satisfaction.

threat_vectors.name: Inventory Imbalance and Obsolescence
threat_vectors.description: Inventory imbalance and obsolescence may lead to lost sales, increased costs, and decreased customer satisfaction. Immediate reordering and inventory monitoring are recommended.

threat_vectors.name: Pricing Anomalies and Sales Data Integrity
threat_vectors.description: Pricing anomalies and sales data integrity issues may impact revenue and profitability. Review and adjustment of product pricing and sales data are recommended.

threat_vectors.name: Supplier Lead Time Analysis
threat_vectors.description: High-velocity products require proactive inventory monitoring to prevent stockouts and lost sales. Review and adjustment of supplier lead times and inventory levels are recommended.

immediate_actions: Reorder 15 products immediately to prevent lost sales
Review and adjust product pricing to ensure competitiveness and profitability
Implement proactive inventory monitoring for high-velocity products
monitoring_recommendations: Continuously monitor inventory levels and supplier lead times to prevent stockouts and lost sales
Regularly review and adjust sales data to ensure accuracy and integrity
